items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: LaVoy used to play with me.

ctx.x: Oh, let's see, who were some of your favorite trombone players when you started out?
Well, LaVoy used to play with me. I've been trying my best to get in touch with him, but I can't find him. Sam Williams, he was a nice trombone player.
